channel.title: Mobikom | Insights & Technical Papers
channel.description: Technical monographs, web performance papers, and telecom historical archives from Mobikom Bulgaria.

item.title: NMT-450 Retrospective: 1992 Cellular Architecture
item.description: Engineering retrospective on Bulgaria's 1992 analog NMT-450 cellular network, radio propagation at 450 MHz, and lessons for modern web infrastructure.

item.title: Computer Memory Architecture & The Web Bloat Penalty
item.description: Technical analysis of computer memory hierarchies, CPU cache locality (L1/L2/L3), and how modern web bloat mismanages physical memory.

item.title: Contextual Advertising Without Surveillance
item.description: Why Mobikom operates direct contextual advertising across dobrichnews.com, dobruja.com, and bestjobs.bg without programmatic tracking cookies.

item.title: Dobruja Media Group: Regional Journalism & Civic Archives
item.description: Delivering verified regional news, community records, and independent editorial oversight across North-East Bulgaria.

item.title: The 512-Byte Web Principle
item.description: Why reducing network round-trips and eradicating unnecessary client-side JavaScript represents the true foundation of sustainable web operations.

item.title: Sea Stars & Pomorie Lye: Mineral Balneology & Digital Preservation
item.description: Scientific monograph on Black Sea mineral balneology, authentic hyper-concentrated Pomorie lye developed with the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences (IONH-BAS), and lightweight digital cataloging.
